server.name: datacircle
server.title: Datacircle
server.description: Query your favorite B2B data APIs through us. Same request, same price, no markup.

protocolMetadata.instructions: Datacircle is a data co-op. Query your favorite B2B data APIs through us. Same request, same price, no markup. Each call costs the provider's price, and we take it from the user's Datacircle balance (we give a credit at sign-up). We add each profile we fetch to the co-op files all members share. Fetch a LinkedIn profile with get_linkedin_profile. Check the balance with get_balance before many calls. If the balance runs low, call add_funds to get the user a Stripe Checkout link. Each day we publish a flat file of every API request: find it with list_files and download it with get_download_link. Docs: https://docs.datacircle.dev/mcp-server

tool.name: get_linkedin_profile
tool.title: Get a LinkedIn profile
tool.description: Fetch one person's LinkedIn profile by its URL: name, headline, location, current company and title, positions, education, skills. It costs what the provider's credits cost us, taken from the Datacircle balance with no markup: up2data $0.002375 per profile found, free when it isn't found, up to $1 a day per account; harvestapi $0.0037 per profile found, every section of the profile; fetchin $0.001485 per lookup, found or not, every section. Every call is live: the provider is asked each time, so the profile is as it is today. The answer is the provider's own JSON plus datacircle_meta {provider, cost_usd, balance_usd}. If up2data answers its daily limit (429), call again with provider fetchin or harvestapi; if the balance is too low (402), add_funds. Details: https://docs.datacircle.dev/pricing

url.description: The profile's LinkedIn URL, like https://www.linkedin.com/in/williamhgates

provider.description: The data provider that fetches the profile, at its own price: up2data is free when it can't find the profile; fetchin costs least per profile found, every section; harvestapi returns every section, the member's interests included. fetchin and harvestapi answer when up2data is at its daily limit

url.description: Canonical public URL of the professional profile page

cost.description: What HarvestAPI billed for the call, e.g. `0.0037` for a profile, `0.0023` for a profile it can't find. Datacircle charges you the same amount in dollars (`datacircle_meta.cost_usd`).

awards.description: Honors and awards on the profile.

skills.description: Capped at the first 20 unless with_full_skills_and_endorsements is true, in which case every skill LinkedIn exposes is returned (up to LinkedIn's own 50-skill cap).

headline.description: The line under the member's name on the profile.

location.description: Where the member is: `raw` as LinkedIn shows it, parsed into `city`, `region` and `country`.

languages.description: Language names listed on the profile. Omitted when none are listed.

positions.description: Full experience history, current roles included.

is_premium.description: `true` when the member has LinkedIn Premium.

scraped_at.description: When Up2Data scraped this profile from LinkedIn (ISO 8601).

profile_urn.description: urn:li:fsd_profile:{ACo…}, the profile id Sales Navigator and LinkedIn messaging use.

certifications.description: Licenses and certifications on the profile.

primary_locale.description: LinkedIn primary locale as language_COUNTRY, e.g. en_US.

current_company.description: The member's current role and its company.

followers_count.description: Included when with_followers_and_connections is true (or listed in fields).

is_open_to_work.description: `true` when the member shows they are open to work.

connections_count.description: Included when with_followers_and_connections is true (or listed in fields).

skill_endorsements.description: Present when with_full_skills_and_endorsements is true (or listed in fields).

language_proficiencies.description: The same languages as `languages`, with the proficiency the member chose, when they chose one.

data.description: Up2Data's profile record, every field as Up2Data documents it (docs.up2data.ai). `fields` in the request restricts it to the fields listed.

free.description: `true` when HarvestAPI didn't bill the call (a request it refuses).

billed.description: Whether Up2Data billed this call (`false`: it didn't, and you weren't charged). What this call costs you is `datacircle_meta.cost_usd`

reason.description: Why Up2Data billed this call or not, in its words, e.g. `profile_found`.

creditsUsed.description: Up2Data credits this call used (1 per profile found). What it costs you is `datacircle_meta.cost_usd`: $0.002375 per Up2Data credit

meta.description: Up2Data's billing metadata, minus `creditsRemaining`, `requestId` and `latencyMs` (our account with Up2Data, not yours)

error.description: HarvestAPI's message when `element` is `null`, e.g. `Profile not found`.

profileId.description: The profile's LinkedIn member id (`ACoAA…`); `null` when not found.

publicIdentifier.description: The profile's slug, linkedin.com/in/<publicIdentifier>; `null` when not found.

query.description: The request as HarvestAPI understood it: the `url` it read, with the `publicIdentifier` and `profileId` it resolved.

title.description: Professional headline. A member can publish their profile in several languages and the source does not translate between them. This is the English version when the member published one, otherwise the version in their primaryLocale. Deterministic: two calls return the same language. Every version they did publish is in titleLocalized / descriptionLocalized.

hiring.description: Whether the profile shows the public #HIRING photo frame. A profile picture carries one frame at most, so hiring and openToWork are never both true.

issuer.description: Who granted it, as free text.

issuedDate.description: When it was awarded, e.g. Oct 2018. A single date - an award has no end.

description.description: The member own description. Omitted when blank.

positionUrn.description: Joins to experiences[].positionUrn when attached to a role.

educationUrn.description: Joins to educations[].educationUrn when attached to a school.

honors.description: Honors and awards listed on the profile, in display order.

skills.description: Professional skills listed on the profile. Complete list, returned in the same single call as the rest of the profile.

status.description: HarvestAPI's own status, inside an HTTP `200`: `200` found, `404` not found, `400` a request it refuses.

number.description: Course code as entered, e.g. "Fin335". Omitted when blank.

positionUrn.description: Joins to experiences[].positionUrn when attached to a role.

educationUrn.description: Joins to educations[].educationUrn when attached to a school.

courses.description: Courses listed on the profile, in display order.

id.description: The profile's LinkedIn member id (`ACoAA…`, case-sensitive).

photo.description: The profile photo's URL (the largest size).

causes.description: The causes the member cares about, e.g. `Education`.

emails.description: Always empty: Datacircle sends HarvestAPI the profile lookup only, without its email search.

creator.description: `true` when the member has creator mode on.

premium.description: `true` when the member has LinkedIn Premium.

featured.description: The profile's Featured section; `null` when it has none.

headline.description: The line under the member's name on the profile.

industry.description: The member's industry, as LinkedIn classifies it: its `id` and `name`.

location.description: Where the member is: `linkedinText` as LinkedIn shows it, and `parsed` into city, state and country.

services.description: The services the member offers (LinkedIn's Services page); `null` when none.

verified.description: `true` when LinkedIn shows the member as verified.

websites.description: The websites listed on the profile.

interests.description: What the member follows, by kind.

objectUrn.description: LinkedIn's numeric id of the member.

topSkills.description: The skills the member put at the top of the profile.

experience.description: Every job on the profile, the newest first.

influencer.description: `true` when LinkedIn marks the member as an influencer (Top Voice).

coverPicture.description: The banner image behind the photo: `url` (the largest image) and `sizes`, every size LinkedIn serves.

memorialized.description: `true` when LinkedIn has memorialized the profile (the member died).

moreProfiles.description: The profiles LinkedIn suggests next to this one ("More profiles for you").

followerCount.description: How many people follow the member.

sectionTotals.description: How many entries each section of the profile has on LinkedIn; a list above may hold fewer.

profileActions.description: The buttons the member added to the profile, e.g. `Visit my website`.

profileLocales.description: Every language the profile is written in.

profilePicture.description: The profile photo: `url` (the largest image) and `sizes`, every size LinkedIn serves.

currentPosition.description: The member's current jobs, the same shape as `experience`.

connectionsCount.description: The member's connections, as LinkedIn counts them (it shows `500+` past 500).

composeOptionType.description: How LinkedIn lets someone not connected write to the member, e.g. `PREMIUM_INMAIL`.

multiLocaleHeadline.description: The headline in each language the profile is written in.

profileTopEducation.description: The school the profile shows under the member's name, the same shape as `education`.

anyOf.description: A LinkedIn profile, as HarvestAPI answers it.

element.description: The profile; `null` when HarvestAPI can't find it (`status` `404`) or refuses the request (`status` `400`).

totals.description: How large the source says each affected section really is, when it reports a size. Keyed by the same names, except experienceGroups - which counts STINTS, because that is the unit the source reports. A stint is one continuous period at one employer, so this is neither a count of roles nor a count of distinct employers: a member who left an employer and came back counts it twice (see experiences[].positionGroupUrn).

sections.description: Names of the response fields that may be short or missing, e.g. ["experiences"]. Possible values: an array that came back shorter than the member real list (experiences, educations, skills, certifications, languages, testScores, publications, projects, patents, honors, organizations, courses, volunteerExperiences); a best-effort field that could not be fetched, or only in part, on this call (recommendations and recommendationsGiven: absent or shorter than the member real list; joinDate, birthDate, websites and openProfile: absent; joinDate, birthDate and websites come from the same read and are listed together; when birthDate is listed it could not be read on this call, otherwise the member's birthday was not visible to us); and with fullProfile=true only, relatedProfiles (the extra page could not be read) and workplaceType (some or all roles could not be checked for one; it is a field of each experience, not a top-level one), and verifications (the profile-details panel could not be read).

partial.description: Present ONLY when part of the response is knowingly incomplete; its absence means nothing was dropped. A profile is assembled from several upstream reads, and when one cannot be completed the affected array is shorter than the member real data - previously indistinguishable from a genuinely short list.

issuer.description: Patent office, as the member typed it (e.g. "us"). Free text, not a controlled vocabulary.

pending.description: Whether the patent is still an application rather than granted. Always present.

issuedDate.description: When granted, e.g. Jan 2017. Omitted while pending.

description.description: The member own description. Omitted when blank.

patents.description: Patents listed on the profile, in display order.

pronoun.description: Publicly displayed pronouns (e.g. "she/her"). Omitted when the member doesn't display pronouns.

retries.description: How many times HarvestAPI retried LinkedIn for this answer.

entityId.description: The profile's LinkedIn member id (`ACoAA…`), as `element.id`; `null` when not found.

industry.description: The member self-declared industry, e.g. "Information Technology & Services". Uses the industry vocabulary the profile page itself displays, which is NOT the same list as the industry field on the company endpoint - do not join the two. Omitted when the member lists none.

jobTitle.description: Title of the member DESIGNATED PRIMARY role (the same entry flagged current in experiences). A designation, not a date test: if the member has not updated their profile since that role ended, jobTitle still reflects it while the matching experience shows ongoing:false.

lastName.description: Profile last name. Some members restrict their full surname to their own contacts; for those profiles this is the publicly displayed initial (e.g. "D.") and lastNameInitialOnly is true. The full surname is not available through any request in that case.

location.description: Where the member is, as the profile shows it.

memberId.description: Numeric internal member id (e.g. "251749025"). Distinct from `id`/`profileId`, which carry the `urn:li:fsd_profile:…` form.

payments.description: What HarvestAPI billed, by name: `linkedinProfile` for a profile, `linkedinProfileShort` for a lookup that found nothing.

dateRange.description: Formatted range, e.g. "Apr 2018 - Mar 2019". Empty string when the member gave no dates.

description.description: The member own description. Omitted when blank.

positionUrn.description: Set when the project is attached to a role. Joins to experiences[].positionUrn.

educationUrn.description: Set when the project is attached to a school. Joins to educations[].educationUrn.

projects.description: Projects listed on the profile, in display order.

topVoice.description: Present and true when the profile carries a recognised-voice badge. ABSENT (not false) when it does not, which is the case for most profiles — treat an absent key as falsy. The badge's display label is not returned because the source translates it per reading session.

category.description: The type the member picked for it, e.g. PERSONAL, COMPANY, BLOG, PORTFOLIO or OTHER

websites.description: The websites listed in the member's contact info, only when their privacy settings make them visible to us, in the order the member listed them. Absent (never an empty array) when there are none to show. Included in every call at no extra cost. Not the same as creatorInfo.website, the single link a creator pins to their profile.

year.description: Only when the member shows it

birthDate.description: The member's birthday, only when their privacy settings make it visible to us; absent when they hide it or never entered it. Members choose who can see it, so one who limits it to a narrower audience may appear on some calls and not on others. Included in every call at no extra cost. Always a month and a day; the year only when the member shares it, which is rare.

grade.description: Grade or honors, as free text (e.g. "First Class Honours")

current.description: Whether this is the person's current (ongoing) education. At most one education is true.

details.description: The member's own free-text description of this education entry. Distinct from `description`, which stays the synthesized degree + field string.

ongoing.description: Whether the studies are still running: a start year and no end year. Note an ongoing education dateRange reads "2022", not "2022 - Present".

activities.description: The "activities and societies" line the member entered for this entry, e.g. "Nature Club, LTS, Elocution". Omitted when blank.

educationUrn.description: URN of this education entity; join key for currentSchool.educationUrn

entityType.description: "Person" for a member profile. "Company" when an organization identifier was supplied: a company, school or showcase URL is accepted here for backward compatibility and returns a REDUCED record (organization name in firstName, tagline in title, empty experiences/educations). Prefer GET /api/v1/company for organizations.

influencer.description: Whether the profile carries the platform's long-standing editorial recognition. Distinct from topVoice: a profile can have one without the other.

isVerified.description: Whether the profile has a verification badge

openToWork.description: Whether the profile shows the public #OPEN_TO_WORK photo frame. Reflects the publicly visible badge only; recruiter-only 'open to work' is not exposed.

date.description: When the test was taken (e.g. Jun 2018)

testScores.description: Test scores listed on the profile

companyName.description: Employer of that same designated role. Same caveat as jobTitle. Derived from the position itself, whereas currentPosition reflects the block the member chooses to DISPLAY at the top of their profile - so currentPosition can be null while jobTitle/companyName are set.

description.description: About/summary section. A member can publish their profile in several languages and the source does not translate between them. This is the English version when the member published one, otherwise the version in their primaryLocale. Deterministic: two calls return the same language. Every version they did publish is in titleLocalized / descriptionLocalized. Line breaks are returned exactly as the source stores them: for some profiles the source holds this text with its line breaks already removed, and they are not reconstructed by guesswork.

geoUrn.description: Stable identifier for the position location, e.g. "urn:li:fsd_geo:107025191". Language-independent - the right key to join or group on.

company.description: Company details. Three cases: the employer has a professional page (url/logo/companyId/urn present alongside name); the member typed an employer with no page (name only); or the member saved no employer at all (name is "" and company is omitted - employmentType usually carries the meaning). An empty name means "no employer entered", never "employer has no page".

current.description: Whether this is the role the member designates as their PRIMARY one (the one shown at the top of their profile). At most one experience is true across the whole response, and it is false when the designated role has already ended. This is a designation, not a date test - use `ongoing` to find every role still running.

ongoing.description: Whether the role is still running: a start date and no end date - exactly the entries whose dateRange ends in "Present". Independent of `current`: ANY number of experiences can be ongoing, and someone holding four concurrent roles has four. An entry saved with no dates at all is false rather than assumed ongoing.

positionUrn.description: URN of this position entity; join key for currentPosition.positionUrn

locationName.description: Job location as the member sees it, in THEIR own profile language (e.g. "Barcelona, Cataluna, Espana"). Free text - use geoId/geoUrn to normalise or group. The profile language is reported in the top-level primaryLocale.

geoLocationName.description: The standardized location caption behind locationName, in the same language.

positionGroupId.description: The key inside `positionGroupUrn`, in the spirit of `companyId` / `geoId`. It is a 40-character hexadecimal string, not a number. Only meaningful together with the profile it came from, so never use it on its own.

positionGroupUrn.description: Which stint this role belongs to. A stint is one continuous period at one employer: roles sharing it were held back to back there and sit next to each other in `experiences`. A member who leaves an employer and returns has TWO stints, i.e. two different values with the same `company.companyId`, so group by this rather than by `companyId`. Opaque, and consistent within one response only: the same stint may get another value on a later fetch. Omitted in the rare case the grouping is not available.

locationNameLocalized.description: Every language the source holds for this location caption, keyed by locale, e.g. {"es_ES": "Barcelona, Cataluna, Espana"}.

experiences.description: Complete work experience history, ordered most recent first. Every position is returned in a single call - there is no pagination to follow, including for members with dozens of past employers and for members holding many successive roles at the same one. If a section could not be completed, the top-level `partial` object names it.

openProfile.description: Whether the member runs an open profile: anyone can message them directly without being one of their connections, and without spending a paid message credit. Unrelated to `openToWork`, and not the same as `premium` (some non-premium members are reachable this way). An ABSENT openProfile means unknown, never false: on a small share of calls it cannot be determined, the key is omitted and partial.sections includes openProfile; requesting the profile again normally returns it. A memorialized account (inRemembrance true) always returns false, since nobody can message it. It is the only status boolean that can be absent on a person profile.

description.description: The member own description. Omitted when blank.

publishedOn.description: The same date structured, when finer than month is available.

publications.description: Publications listed on the profile, in display order.

schoolId.description: Legacy school id from urn:li:fsd_school:<id>; distinct from companyId

companyId.description: Numeric organization id of the school's page, usable with the company endpoints

educationUrn.description: URN of the designated education entry; matches educations[].educationUrn

currentSchool.description: Explicit "education" block from the top of the profile page. Object when the member displays it, null when they don't.

inRemembrance.description: Whether the account has been officially memorialized ('In Remembrance'). Only a memorialized account returns true: a regular profile whose headline mentions the member has passed away returns false.

dateRange.description: Formatted range, e.g. "2015 - Jun 2016". Empty string when no dates were given.

description.description: The member own description. Omitted when blank.

positionUrn.description: Joins to experiences[].positionUrn when attached to a role.

educationUrn.description: Joins to educations[].educationUrn when attached to a school.

positionHeld.description: The role the member held there, e.g. "Membership Chairperson".

organizations.description: Organizations the member belongs to, in display order.

primaryLocale.description: The language the member AUTHORED their profile in, e.g. "es_ES". It does not by itself say which language the free text beside it is in - see title and description. For language-independent values use geoUrn, industryUrn or companyId.

authority.description: Legacy alias of organizationName, kept for backward compatibility

dateRange.description: Legacy alias of issuedDate, kept for backward compatibility

issuedDate.description: When the certification was issued (e.g. Jun 2018). When the credential also expires, this string carries both dates (Jun 2018 - Jun 2026) for backward compatibility - read expirationDate for the expiry on its own.

credentialId.description: The credential ID the member entered, as free text. Omitted when blank.

credentialUrl.description: The "show credential" link the member entered. Omitted when blank.

expirationDate.description: When the credential expires (e.g. Jun 2026). Omitted when it does not expire.

organizationUrl.description: Issuing organization's professional page URL, when available

organizationLogo.description: Issuing organization logo image URL, when a professional page is linked.

width.description: Width in pixels, as declared by the source. Omitted when it declares none.

height.description: Height in pixels, as declared by the source. Omitted when it declares none.

items.description: One size of an image. Read the size from `width` and `height`, never from the URL: the size written in the URL path is the size that was requested and can differ from the file served. Image URLs are signed and stop working after an expiry date the source sets (their `e=` query parameter), which we do not control; download an image to keep it rather than storing its URL.

coverImageUrls.description: Every size of the banner image, smallest first. Banners are not square, so use both `width` and `height`. Absent when the member has no banner, in which case `coverImageUrl` is absent too.

titleLocalized.description: title in each language the member published, keyed by locale ("fr_FR", "en_US").

title.description: Role title of the designated position

companyId.description: Numeric company id, usable with the company endpoints

positionUrn.description: URN of the designated position; matches experiences[].positionUrn

currentPosition.description: Explicit "current company" block from the top of the profile page. Object when the member displays it, null when they don't (an ongoing primary position may still exist in experiences).

cost_usd.description: what this call cost, in dollars: the provider's price, no markup

balance_usd.description: your balance after this call, in dollars (`balance_usd` in `GET /balance/`)

datacircle_meta.description: Datacircle's only addition to the provider's answer

caption.description: The recommender's headline at the time of the fetch (the context line shown under the author's name)

authorUrl.description: The recommender's public profile page URL

createdAt.description: When the recommendation was written, ISO 8601. Omitted when the source carries no timestamp.

lastModifiedAt.description: When it was last edited, ISO 8601. Equal to createdAt when it was never edited.

recommendations.description: Recommendations received by the member. Best-effort: omitted when this section could not be fetched, empty array when the member has none.

volunteerCauses.description: Volunteer causes listed on the profile

supportedLocales.description: Every language the member published their profile in, e.g. ["fr_FR","en_US"]. A member who wrote their profile once gets a single-entry array, so more than one entry is the signal that titleLocalized / descriptionLocalized have something to choose from.

profilePictureUrl.description: Profile picture URL, largest size available. Always a string: when the member has no photo of their own it holds a generic placeholder image and `profilePictureUrls` is absent.

width.description: Width in pixels, as declared by the source. Omitted when it declares none.

height.description: Height in pixels, as declared by the source. Omitted when it declares none.

items.description: One size of an image. Read the size from `width` and `height`, never from the URL: the size written in the URL path is the size that was requested and can differ from the file served. Image URLs are signed and stop working after an expiry date the source sets (their `e=` query parameter), which we do not control; download an image to keep it rather than storing its URL.

profilePictureUrls.description: Every size of the profile picture, smallest first, one entry per distinct size (how many varies: a small original comes in fewer sizes); the last entry is the image `profilePictureUrl` points to (the framed picture when the member displays a photo frame). ABSENT, not empty and not null, when the member has no photo of their own, which is how to tell a real photo from the placeholder in `profilePictureUrl`. Not returned for organization records.

lastNameInitialOnly.description: Present and true only when lastName is an initial because the member restricts it. Absent otherwise, never false.

descriptionLocalized.description: description in each language the member published, keyed by locale.

caption.description: The recipient's headline at the time of the fetch.

createdAt.description: When the recommendation was written, ISO 8601. Omitted when the source carries no timestamp.

recipientUrl.description: The recipient's public profile page URL.

lastModifiedAt.description: When it was last edited, ISO 8601. Equal to createdAt when it was never edited.

recipientFullname.description: Full name of the person who was recommended.

recommendationsGiven.description: Recommendations the member WROTE for other people. Best-effort, exactly like `recommendations`: an empty array means they wrote none, while an ABSENT key means the fetch failed and `partial` will say so. tool.name: get_balance
tool.title: Get the balance
tool.description: Read the Datacircle balance, in USD: balance_usd is everything calls can spend now, then what it is made of: signup_credit_usd (left of the sign-up credit), funds_usd (left of the funds added), manual_credit_usd, and temporary_credits, each with its campaign, credit_usd and expires_at. Read it to know whether the balance covers the calls you are about to make. Free.

funds_usd.description: Permanent: what is left of the funds added to this account. Never expires.

balance_usd.description: Everything you can spend right now, in dollars: `signup_credit_usd` + `funds_usd` + `manual_credit_usd` (permanent) + every `temporary_credits[].credit_usd` (temporary). `datacircle_meta.balance_usd` on a provider call is this number after the call.

manual_credit_usd.description: Permanent: what is left of the credits Datacircle added to your workspace by hand (a refund, a gift, a deal). Never expires. 0 for most workspaces.

signup_credit_usd.description: Permanent: what is left of the $5 signup credit every workspace gets once. Never expires.

campaign.description: The campaign that gave this credit, by its name.

credit_usd.description: Temporary: what is left of this credit until `expires_at`, in dollars. Also capped by what is left of the campaign's shared budget, so it can drop to 0 before then.

expires_at.description: When this grant expires (ISO 8601): after it, what is left is gone.

temporary_credits.description: Temporary credits: one entry per campaign grant that has not expired yet, soonest to expire first; empty when you have none. At `expires_at` the entry leaves this list and whatever is left of it is gone.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Datacircle to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Datacircle to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.datacircle.dev/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Datacircle MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 10, 2026, Datacircle scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Datacircle's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 10, 2026, Datacircle scores 94/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 5 of 5 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Datacircle?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Datacircle in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Tolt, and Affitor.
